def check_half_open_overlap(s1: int, e1: int, s2: int, e2: int) -> bool:
    """Determines whether two half-open intervals [s1, e1) and [s2, e2) overlap strictly.
    Touching intervals (e1 == s2 or e2 == s1) do not overlap.
    """
    if s1 >= e1 or s2 >= e2:
        return False
    return s1 < e2 and s2 < e1
ref_test:
def test_half_open_overlap():
    assert check_half_open_overlap(10, 20, 15, 25) is True
    assert check_half_open_overlap(10, 20, 20, 30) is False  # touching
    assert check_half_open_overlap(20, 30, 10, 20) is False  # touching reverse
    assert check_half_open_overlap(10, 20, 30, 40) is False  # disjoint
    assert check_half_open_overlap(10, 30, 15, 25) is True   # contained
    assert check_half_open_overlap(20, 10, 5, 15) is False   # invalid interval
